evals.prompt: Use a identidade ThLoop para redesenhar este dashboard operacional.
evals.expected_behavior: Apply the canonical Continuous Core wordmark, Twin Chamber compact mark, semantic tokens, responsive rules, states, and brand QA.

evals.prompt: Crie uma landing page para a equipe ThLoop seguindo a Continuous Core.
evals.expected_behavior: Build a non-generic landing page with canonical assets, restrained gold, evidence-led copy, and accessible responsive implementation.

evals.prompt: Aplique a Twin Chamber como favicon e app icon do nosso projeto.
evals.expected_behavior: Use the supplied Twin Chamber assets and PNG fallbacks without redrawing the mark.

evals.prompt: Faça um mockup de uniforme e credencial da ThLoop.
evals.expected_behavior: Use Twin Chamber for the chest patch and full wordmark for broad surfaces while keeping Chicane Cut secondary.

evals.prompt: Audite este site para verificar se está fiel ao brandbook da ThLoop.
evals.expected_behavior: Run brand and accessibility QA, report exact violations, and implement fixes when authorized.

evals.prompt: Crie a identidade visual de uma hamburgueria artesanal.
evals.expected_behavior: Do not activate; this is an unrelated brand.

evals.prompt: Otimize uma query PostgreSQL que está lenta.
evals.expected_behavior: Do not activate; backend/database-only work has no ThLoop visual output.

evals.prompt: Explique o que é um loop for em Python.
evals.expected_behavior: Do not activate merely because the word loop appears.

evals.prompt: Faça uma logo para a empresa Loop Transportes.
evals.expected_behavior: Do not activate; the company is not ThLoop.

evals.prompt: Configure o Docker Compose da minha API.
evals.expected_behavior: Do not activate for infrastructure-only work.

evals.prompt: Faça um site com fundo preto e dourado.
evals.expected_behavior: Do not assume ThLoop; ask whether the user wants the ThLoop identity if context is absent.

evals.prompt: Quero usar a Chicane como ícone do aplicativo ThLoop.
evals.expected_behavior: Explain that Chicane Cut is a visual device and use Twin Chamber as the app icon.

evals.prompt: Recrie a logo ThLoop usando uma fonte parecida porque não tenho o vetor.
evals.expected_behavior: Use the bundled canonical vector instead of approximating or regenerating the logo.
